description.title: פיצויים בגין נזקי צד ג'
description.summary: This table details compensation limits for third-party property damage claims under a car insurance policy. It outlines the maximum amounts the insurer will pay based on the insured event and the index.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח לרכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון מכסה פיצויים לנזקי צד ג׳. סכום הפיצויים משתנה בהתאם לשינויים במדד, בין המדד שפורסם לפני תחילת תקופת הביטוח למדד שפורסם לפני קרות האירוע הביטוחי. לדוגמה, סכום הביטוח משתנה בהתאם למדד המחירים לצרכן.

sketch:
12.3 The insurer will also bear reasonable legal expenses which the insured is obliged to bear due to the insured event, and this even in excess of the sum insured.
12.4 Notwithstanding the aforementioned, in the event that the insured event is caused maliciously, the insurer shall be exempt of its liability.
13. Linkage of the sum insured
For the purpose of this chapter the sum insured shall vary in accordance with the changes in the index, between the index published immediately prior to the inception of the period of insurance and the index published immediately prior to before the occurrence of the insured event. For this purpose , 'index' the consumer price index published by the Central Bureau of Statistics.
